clause_text: Black (c) At least 10% of latest fiscal-year revenue comes from immigration detention, or immigration detainee monitoring or transport, as disclosed in the company's own 10-K: 47.6% of fiscal-year 2025 revenue (10-K filed 2026-02-25; threshold 10%)
summary: GEO Group's 10-K for fiscal 2025 states that ICE accounted for 47.6% of its total consolidated revenues (41.5% in 2024).
caveat: The 10-K gives ICE's share of total consolidated revenues, not a separate "immigration detention" line. This screen treats ICE contract revenue as the clause (c) measure, as in the rule's own example. GEO's ICE revenue includes an electronic-monitoring contract (ISAP) as well as detention; both fall under clause (c).

evidence.publisher: The GEO Group, Inc. Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025 (SEC EDGAR)
evidence.quote: ICE accounting for 47.6% and 41.5% of our total consolidated revenues for 2025 and 2024, respectively
